card.title: Say You Saw It Too
card.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you send this soup back, did you notice anything moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm complaining about cold noodles. What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me whether one waved. I need your word before I explain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It waved me closer. I'm still not eating it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll understand why I've ordered it lunch. Could you ask whether it wants your bread?

mechanism: A asks B to confirm a noodle's deliberate gesture before admitting A has treated it as a diner.
confusable: Unlike recruiting belief immediately, A must withhold the extent of A's own belief until receiving corroboration.
comparison: A restaurant complaint delays the disclosure of ordered lunch for the noodle, unlike the shadow scene's admission of door-holding.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
